posts.name: arenson9
posts.cooked:
Christopher and Adam are planning to be at Arsenal on Tuesday, August 13th, some time after 5pm.

 

Sorry about the ambiguity in the timing, but this is going to be a pretty informal, thrown-together at the last minute thing. Through what, as far as I can tell, is some sort of fluke and/or miscommunication, Arsenal had 'Greater Than Games creators' on their schedule for Tue the 13th. That surprised me, so I asked Christopher about it and Christopher said that he didn't know about it, but there's no reason they _couldn't_ get into town early enough to do it, so they will.

 

Please give a shout if you think you can make it, but also feel free just to show up.

posts.name: bessyrocks12
posts.cooked: Had a great meetup with Christopher and Adam at Arsenal Tuesday. Over 25 people playing on 5 tables! Too many games to keep up with, but had a couple of great matches, including a overly agressive Omnitron with at Tomb of Anubis at 9 trials. Slow start for the heroes, but Tachyon souped up on bursts and Chrono Ranger hitting for 10 a turn with his Compound Bow took him down 46 in two turns. Second game was not nearly as hard against Apostate with heavy damage being dealt every turn. I know everyone at Arsenal had a great time.
